allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
refactor\(entities\): clean up and standardize entity layer

- Fix typo sport_id -> spot_id in BookingEntity
- Add @Builder.Default on fields with default values
- Remove redundant timestamp handling \(keep @PrePersist/@PreUpdate\)
- Remove unnecessary custom constructors
- Rename stopTime -> endTime for consistency
- Add createdAt/updatedAt audit fields to EventEntity, CustomerEventEntity, CommentEntity
- Remove dead code: CustomerBookingEntity, event_participants relation
- Fix formatting issues
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
refactor\(controllers\): add OpenAPI documentation and standardize REST conventions

- Add @RequestMapping to AvailabilityController, BookingParticipantController, InstructorSpotController
- Add @Tag and @Operation annotations to all 12 controllers \(~75 endpoints\)
- Fix HTTP verbs: POST to PATCH for cancel, suspend, reactivate, resend
- Move customerId to BookingCreateRequest DTO
- Move getInstructorsBySpot to SpotController
- Remove unused getAvailabilityById method
- Fix incorrect log messages \(POST -> PATCH\)
EOF
\)")
